//: Scope to the authored barrel: tsc checks src/index.ts plus everything it transitively imports (the whole useful generated tree). The generated top-level aggregation barrels (generated/index.ts, pub/layers/index.ts, examples.ts) are redundant with src/index.ts, are hidden by the package `exports` map, and carry known upstream codegen-barrel bugs (empty examples re-export; duplicate Entry), so they are deliberately not type-checked.
